_what: What each codeline IS and what an agent working inside it needs to know that the source does not say. Produced by the codeline-discovery agent during THIS run and rewritten every run — never accumulated, so nothing here is older than the run that wrote it. The engine splits this per codeline into each worktree's .epam/.
_shape: Codeline names are TOP-LEVEL keys, because the engine extracts one with jq '.[$cl]'. Nesting them under another key parses fine and yields nothing for every codeline.

facts.text: Tests are run with `jest`; the `pretest` script runs `npm run build:config` first (esbuild of next.config.source.ts), so a missing next.config.js will cause test failures even if the code is correct.
Jest has a global coverage threshold of 60% for branches, functions, lines, and statements; changes that lower coverage below this will fail `test:coverage-check`.
facts.source: jest.config.js: coverageThreshold.global { branches: 60, functions: 60, lines: 60, statements: 60 }

facts.text: The husky pre-commit hook runs `npx lint-staged` and enforces branch naming with regex `^(feature|bugfix|tech|release|hotfix)/[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+(/[a-z0-9-]+)?$`; commits from branches not matching this pattern are rejected.
Commit messages must follow Jira-rules format enforced by commitlint with `commitlint-plugin-jira-rules`; the commit-msg hook runs `npx --no-install commitlint --edit`.
lint-staged runs `npm run check-types` (tsc --noEmit) on any staged `src/**/*.ts(x)` file, so TypeScript type errors will block the commit.
